principles: Preserve FAIL-is-terminal as the default for every non-allowlisted smoke
Open the retry path only via an explicit, documented, serial-verified allowlist
Never blindly retry FAILs — that would mask real regressions
Stopgap now, shared-state root cause deferred
drivers: test:all must be deterministically green to gate CI
B-2941 timeout-only retry leaves load-induced FAILs red
retrying all FAILs is unsafe so an allowlist is the safe middle

options.name: (a) opt-in retryOnAnyFailure allowlist (chosen)
cons: Each entry risks masking that smoke own future regression

options.name: (c) retry all FAILs
cons: Masks genuine regressions, defeats the CI gate

rationale: User picked the allowlist over retry-all-FAILs as the safe middle. The default stays FAIL-terminal so real bugs surface; only documented serial-verified load-flake smokes opt in.

preMortem.scenario: An allowlisted smoke develops a REAL bug and is silently retried to green
preMortem.trigger: a flagged smoke FAILs for a non-load reason and pass-2 masks it
preMortem.mitigation: keep the allowlist tiny + documented; each entry is a candidate for the deferred root-cause story; a flagged smoke that FAILs BOTH passes still counts FAIL (self-smoke proves this)

preMortem.scenario: A candidate is not actually serial-stable and gets allowlisted
preMortem.trigger: DEV flags a smoke without re-verifying serial PASS
preMortem.mitigation: CHK-002 requires re-running each candidate serial and confirming exit 0 before flagging; drop any that is not serial-stable

preMortem.scenario: The predicate change accidentally retries non-allowlisted FAILs
preMortem.mitigation: self-smoke negative case: a non-flagged FAIL is NOT retried; run before REVIEW
